answer: A hostile operator running 45 aliases therefore needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in opal, expire in delta, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4922 identities would post 639 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
